slides.title: Four control points give each dispute one owner and an auditable path to closure

steps.label: Capture
steps.description: Finance creates one case record, links the invoice and assigns a reason code.

steps.label: Assign
steps.description: The market lead names a resolver; cases without an owner escalate after 24 hours.

steps.label: Resolve
steps.description: The resolver agrees the action; credits above EUR25k require a second approval.

steps.label: Close
steps.description: Finance verifies cash or credit, closes the case and updates recurring-cause rules.

slides.takeaway: Automate routing and evidence capture; retain human approval for commercial exceptions.
